name: review-queue
description: PRs waiting on your review or re-review, polled from GitHub into the dock's Reviews section

account.title: GitHub account
account.description: The gh account whose reviews to track (gh auth status lists them).

org.title: Organization
org.description: Only PRs in this GitHub org. Empty for every repo the account sees.

staleDays.title: Stale after (days)
staleDays.description: PRs with no activity for longer than this are left out and counted as stale.

pollMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often GitHub is asked. One GraphQL request per check.

skipAuthors.title: Skip authors (regex)
skipAuthors.description: PRs by matching logins are left out: service accounts and bots. Drafts are always left out.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: The in-terminal toast. always: new re-reviews and new review requests. rereview: only PRs ready for re-review. off: none.

notify.title: Desktop notification
notify.description: always: new re-reviews and new review requests. rereview: only PRs ready for re-review. off: none.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A short double tone. always, rereview (only PRs ready for re-review) or off.

toastSeconds.title: Toast duration (seconds)
toastSeconds.description: How long the in-terminal toast stays up.
